info.title: FreightUtils API
info.description: The neutral freight reference layer for AI agents: reference and calculation APIs for dangerous goods, customs, locations and freight math that agents can call and cite. No freight to sell, no carrier to push. Anon 25/day per IP, free key 100/day, Pro 50k/month — freightutils.com/pricing.

get.description: Calculate loading metres (LDM) for pallets on a vehicle. Supports preset pallet sizes or custom dimensions. Returns utilisation percentage, pallet spaces, and fit warnings.

parameters.name: pallet
parameters.description: Preset pallet type. If omitted, length and width are required.

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: Pallet length in millimetres. Required if no pallet preset is specified.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Pallet width in millimetres. Required if no pallet preset is specified.

parameters.name: qty
parameters.description: Number of pallets — a whole number from 1 to 9007199254740991 (default 1). Anything else, such as 2.5 or 1e+21, is refused with 400, never rounded.

parameters.name: stackable
parameters.description: Whether the pallets are stackable.

parameters.name: stack
parameters.description: Stack factor: 2 or 3 pallets per floor position. Only read when stackable is true.

parameters.name: weight
parameters.description: Weight per pallet in kilograms.

parameters.name: vehicle
parameters.description: Vehicle type for utilisation calculation. DEPRECATED: rigid10 — removal in 3.0.0. It still answers with its own figures and returns a DEPRECATED advisory in warnings[]; its 10 m length is published by no manufacturer. Use custom with vehicle_length, or artic. Any other value is refused with 400.

parameters.name: vehicle_length
parameters.description: The custom vehicle's load length in metres, greater than 0 — required when vehicle is 'custom' (fits and utilisation are measured against it); ignored otherwise.

200.description: Successful LDM calculation.

400.description: Invalid or missing parameters — an unknown vehicle, a custom vehicle without a vehicle_length above 0, or a qty that is not a whole number. The details name each one.

424.description: Only with ?if_stale=refuse: a dataset of the answer missed its upstream window.

get.description: Calculate the chargeable weight for air freight shipments by comparing actual gross weight against volumetric weight.

parameters.name: l
parameters.description: Length in centimetres.

parameters.name: w
parameters.description: Width in centimetres.

parameters.name: h
parameters.description: Height in centimetres.

parameters.name: gw
parameters.description: Gross weight in kilograms of ALL pieces together (the total, not one piece); l/w/h are per piece.

parameters.name: pcs
parameters.description: Number of pieces — a whole number from 1 to 9007199254740991 (default 1). Anything else, such as 2.5 or 1e+21, is refused with 400, never rounded.

parameters.name: factor
parameters.description: Volumetric divisor in cm³ per kg — a whole number from 1 to 9007199254740991. Standard air freight is 6000 (default); express carriers typically use 5000.

parameters.name: mode

get.description: Look up ADR dangerous goods data by UN number, name search, or hazard class filter. Provide exactly one search parameter.

parameters.name: un
parameters.description: UN number to look up (e.g. 1203, UN1203 or UN 1203).

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search term to find substances by name.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive partial match on the proper shipping name (min 2 characters). A paged list: total, truncated, next_offset; no match is a 404 with suggestions — the closest proper shipping names in Table A.

parameters.name: class
parameters.description: ADR hazard class (Table A column (3a)), e.g. 3, 6.1, 8. A paged list: total, truncated, next_offset.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Name search / class filter only: rows to skip (default 0). The response gives total, truncated and next_offset.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Name search / class filter only: rows per page — 1 to 50 for a search (default 50), 1 to 100 for a class (default 100).

parameters.name: un_numbers
parameters.description: Batch: up to 50 UN numbers, comma-separated. Answered as results[] in input order, each with its own status; send alone. One call against the daily budget, N against the Pro monthly allowance.

parameters.name: include_codes
parameters.description: none | compact | full — resolved_codes beside results: each Table A code once per answer, with the rows that carry it. Default compact for un, none for search, class and un_numbers.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: statements — adds statements[] to every row: plain-word statements (tunnel, transport category, labels, packing, tanks, carriage) assembled from the code meanings and the 8.6.4 and 1.1.3.6.3 tables, each with basis, codes and verification_status.

200.description: Matching ADR substance records.

400.description: Invalid or missing parameters.

424.description: Only with ?if_stale=refuse: a dataset of the answer missed its upstream window.

get.description: Check one line of dangerous goods carried in packages against the ADR 1.1.3.6 small-load exemption: quantity × transport-category multiplier within 1,000 points and within the category's 1.1.3.6.3 maximum; category 0 never qualifies. ID-prefixed numbers (ID8000) route AIR_ONLY_ID.

parameters.name: un
parameters.description: UN number of the substance — or an ID-prefixed air-only number (e.g. ID8000): no ADR Table A entry, so it is routed AIR_ONLY_ID and nothing is counted for it — the ADR answer for limited-quantity packages to the ICAO TI (3.4.9, 3.4.10, 1.1.3.6.5), as its warning states.

parameters.name: qty
parameters.description: Quantity on the ADR 1.1.3.6.3 basis: net kg for solids and liquefied, refrigerated or dissolved gases; litres for liquids; receptacle water capacity in litres for compressed or adsorbed gases and chemicals under pressure; articles as the mass of the articles without their packagings, in kg.

parameters.name: packing_group
parameters.description: Packing group (I, II or III) — only needed for a UN number with more than one ADR Table A row (e.g. UN 1789); ignored for single-row UNs. Without it a multi-variant UN returns candidates[] and no verdict. Enough alone when the rows it leaves agree on the verdict fields (UN 1790 PG I).

parameters.name: variant_index
parameters.description: ADR Table A variant index (as returned by /api/adr) — pins one row when a UN number has several variants sharing a packing group (concentration bands). Ignored for single-row UN numbers. Digits only; anything else is a 400.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.description: OPTIONAL dimension of qty. Omit it and qty is taken as already on the 1.1.3.6.3 basis (unchanged). Supply it and it is checked against the dimension the row is counted in; a mismatch returns points, total_points and exempt all null with basis_mismatch true. Case-insensitive; else 400.

parameters.name: basis
parameters.description: OPTIONAL. ADR 1.1.3.6.3 counts the dangerous goods themselves, never the packaging, so a figure declared "gross" returns no points in ANY unit — send the net quantity instead.

200.description: ADR 1.1.3.6 result; items[].state names each line's route (COUNTED, AIR_ONLY_ID, NOT_SUBJECT_TO_ADR, BLOCKED). All lines ambiguous: human_review_required + blocking_errors[AMBIGUOUS_UN_VARIANT] + candidates[], no verdict; a mixed load withholds that line only. Agreeing rows resolve.

400.description: Invalid input — e.g. a quantity that is not a number > 0, an unknown unit or basis, an unknown UN number, or a parameter the route does not read (refused by name with the accepted ones listed, never ignored). The error names what arrived.

424.description: Only with ?if_stale=refuse: a dataset of the answer missed its upstream window.

post.description: Check a load carried in packages against the ADR 1.1.3.6 small-load exemption: the 1.1.3.6.4 points sum within 1,000, each 1.1.3.6.3 category maximum (a total when every line is one category) and no category 0. items[].state names each line's route.

200.description: ADR 1.1.3.6 result; items[].state names each line's route (COUNTED, AIR_ONLY_ID, NOT_SUBJECT_TO_ADR, BLOCKED). All lines ambiguous: human_review_required + blocking_errors[AMBIGUOUS_UN_VARIANT] + candidates[], no verdict; a mixed load withholds that line only. Agreeing rows resolve.

400.description: Invalid input — e.g. a quantity that is not a number > 0, an unknown unit or basis, an unknown UN number, a single-substance field sent beside items[], or any field the route does not read — refused by name, never dropped. The error names what arrived.

424.description: Only with ?if_stale=refuse: a dataset of the answer missed its upstream window.

parameters.name: icao

post.summary: UK import duty and VAT estimator
post.description: Estimate UK import duty and VAT from the live GOV.UK Trade Tariff. Only ad valorem duties are computed: a specific or compound duty (sugar 1701991000: "35.00 GBP / 100 kg") is answered duty_status "unsupported" with the HMRC expression quoted and figures null, never 0.

commodity_code.description: UK commodity code. A declarable code is 10 digits; a 6- or 8-digit code is refused with HTTP 400 and declarable_codes — the 10-digit codes beneath it in the UK Trade Tariff — never padded with zeros.

customs_value.description: Goods value in GBP, greater than 0 — a number, or its digits as text. Anything else is refused with 400.

freight_cost.description: Freight cost in GBP, 0 or more (default 0). A negative or non-numeric cost is refused with 400 — it would change the CIF value duty is charged on.

insurance_cost.description: Insurance cost in GBP, 0 or more (default 0). A negative or non-numeric cost is refused with 400 — it would change the CIF value duty is charged on.

oneOf.description: Batch: up to 10 lines, each a single-call body, answered as results[] in input order (each line its own receipt). One call against the daily budget, N against Pro monthly.

200.description: Duty and VAT estimate. duty_status "ok" (ad valorem, figures computed) or "unsupported" (duty_form specific | compound | other, duty_expression quoted, figures null).

400.description: Invalid parameters: a commodity_code that is not 10 digits (a 6- or 8-digit code is refused with declarable_codes, the 10-digit codes beneath it in the UK Trade Tariff), an origin_country that is not ISO 3166-1, a customs_value not above 0, or a negative cost.

404.description: HMRC answered 404: the 10-digit commodity code is not in the UK Trade Tariff (with a hint naming declarable codes under it where there are any).

424.description: Only with ?if_stale=refuse: a dataset of the answer missed its upstream window.

503.description: The UK Trade Tariff (HMRC) did not answer (network failure, timeout, 5xx or 429). {error:"upstream_unavailable", message, retryable:true, upstream, upstream_status}; Retry-After: 60. The commodity code was not checked — this is never a "not found". Envelope: UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE.

get.summary: EU tariff lookup (TARIC): the measures on a CN or TARIC code for a date
get.description: Whether the code exists and is declarable, and every measure on it by TARIC's cascade from its parent lines (DG TAXUD's monthly extraction). as_of is mandatory: the extraction's reference date. Codes, measures and rates only; the wording links to the TARIC consultation. Envelope 1.2.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: CN code (8 digits) or TARIC code (10 digits); spaces and dots allowed.

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD; the extraction's reference date (any other date is refused, 422, naming the window).

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: ISO 3166 country code or a 4-digit TARIC country-group code. Without it every measure on the code is listed.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: import (default) or export.

parameters.name: envelope
parameters.description: This route answers in envelope 1.2 only; leave it out or send 1.2.

200.description: The code and its measures: result.exists, result.declarable (result.declarable_codes_below when not), result.measures[], result.wording.consultation_url, result.attribution.

items.description: One TARIC measure. No description of the goods, the additional code or any condition is served.

origin.description: Import: the origin area (code and English name).

source.description: The duty exactly as the extraction publishes it.

attached_to.description: The line the measure is attached to (the code or a parent).

measure_type.name: Suspension - goods for certain categories of ships, boats and other vessels and for drilling or production platforms

series.name: Entry into free circulation or exportation subject to conditions

wording.note: No goods description is served: read the code's wording on the Commission's TARIC consultation.

No binding tariff information (BTI) and no classification: the code is yours to give.

overall_status.description: not_applicable = every item is NOT SUBJECT TO ADR (Table A scope flag) — LQ/EQ provisions do not apply. inconclusive = every in-scope item could not be compared (see items[].status). A batch holding ANY inconclusive or withheld item never reads qualifies.

variant_index.description: The resolved ADR Table A variant index for this row. Null on a withheld item.

ambiguity_reason.description: Why the withheld item could not be pinned. Present only with withheld.

equivalent_variants.description: Present when the supplied packing_group left several Table A rows that agree on class, column (7a), column (7b) and scope: the rows this verdict holds for. The row fields above are the first one's.

variant_note.description: Plain-language statement of the equivalence. Present only with equivalent_variants.

not_subject_to_adr.description: Present and true for a Table A NOT SUBJECT TO ADR row.

carriage_prohibited.description: Present and true for a Table A CARRIAGE PROHIBITED row (status not_permitted).

conditions_ref.description: ADR section whose carriage conditions still apply (e.g. 5.5.3).

not_subject.description: Count of out-of-scope items. Emitted only when non-zero.

inconclusive.description: Count of items that could not be compared (unit family mismatch). Emitted only when non-zero.

candidates.description: The withheld items' candidate Table A rows, each tagged with the item_index and un_number they belong to. Present only with human_review_required.

recorded_at.description: The data commit's commit date: when the change was recorded in the repository with the data. Not a merge, deploy or upstream publication date.

granularity.description: record: the events below name each changed record. dataset: the file changed and no record events are given — re-fetch every record you hold from it (record_diff says why).

record_diff.description: "built", or "unavailable: …" (no served projection for record events yet), or "withheld: … resync" (more than 25% of the records changed, or a schema change made every record differ).

from_edition.description: The edition token of the version ids before (not a date of this release).

schema_change.description: Present when the served fields themselves changed: one dataset-level fact, never a mass amendment.

values.description: Whether events carry before / after values: only for clean or attribution required (met) datasets, never on deleted.

attribution.description: The line to show beside the values, where values are carried.

fu_id.description: The record's entity identifier; join on it, and re-fetch through GET /api/resolve?q=<fu_id> (a deleted record's id resolves to nothing).

from_version.description: The version id before the release — a historical name: an old edition's version id does not resolve. Null for added.

to_version.description: The version id after the release (what a re-fetch returns). Null for deleted.

fields.description: Served field names: those that changed (amended), or those the record serves (added / deleted).

before.description: Amended only, and only where the block says values: true — the changed fields before.

after.description: Amended and added only, and only where the block says values: true — the changed fields after (added: the record as served).

_source.description: The citation of the values in this block (the dataset's _source), where values are carried.

400.description: A malformed since, cursor, limit or format (refused with the accepted form), since with cursor, or an unknown parameter (refused by name).

get.summary: ADR 2027 list check — what ADR 2027 changes for each UN number
get.description: For up to 200 UN numbers: what the ADR 2027 amendments change in Table A — served columns with ADR 2025 and ADR 2027 values, new and deleted entries, or a no-change line — each cited to the UNECE document and PDF page. Table A only. Best-effort, not legal advice.

parameters.name: un
parameters.description: UN numbers: 1203, UN 1203 or UN1203, separated by commas, semicolons, spaces or new lines. Duplicates are ignored, order is kept. More than 200 unique numbers is refused (400), never answered in part.

parameters.name: envelope
parameters.description: Envelope v1 / 1.1 / 1.2 (opt-in): the same answer under result, with confidence high / deterministic and the ADR 2027 source.

200.description: The check of the list: per UN number its kinds, changes and lines with citations; the summary counts; the tokens not read as a UN number; the ADR 2027 status sentences. The same answer /adr/changes-2027/check renders.

summary.description: How many UN numbers count in each kind (a UN number can count in two, e.g. a served change and a further new entry).

in_adr_2025.description: False for a UN number ADR 2025 Table A does not have (a new entry, or not in Table A).

names.description: The ADR 2025 proper shipping names (or the new entry's name).

changes.description: Changes to Table A columns FreightUtils serves.

entry.description: Which row of a multi-row UN number ("PG III"); null on a one-row UN number.

column.description: The Table A column, e.g. "(3b) Classification code".

adr_2027_value.description: Null when the value is in the source document only (see_source).

change.description: As the page shows it: "2F → 2FC", or "see the source document".

document.description: The UNECE document symbol, e.g. ECE/TRANS/WP.15/274.

page.description: The PDF page the change is on; null where the change list names none.

text.description: The citation as the page shows it, e.g. "ECE/TRANS/WP.15/274, PDF p. 15".

lines.description: One plain line each: a new entry, a deletion, a change only in unserved columns, no Table A change, or not in Table A.

document.description: The UNECE document symbol, e.g. ECE/TRANS/WP.15/274.

page.description: The PDF page the change is on; null where the change list names none.

text.description: The citation as the page shows it, e.g. "ECE/TRANS/WP.15/274, PDF p. 15".

rejected.description: Tokens not read as a UN number, as typed.

cap.description: The most UN numbers one check takes (200).

adr_2027.description: The ADR 2027 status as the depositary record states it, and the dates that follow.

check_source.description: Where the ADR 2027 values come from.

scope.description: What the check covers: Table A only.

notice.description: The liability line: best-effort, not legal advice.

page_url.description: The same check on the site; the list travels in ?un=, nothing is stored.

csv_url.description: The same check as CSV, one row per change.

_source.description: UNECE, ADR 2027: ADR 2025 Table A with every amendment of ECE/TRANS/WP.15/274, Add.1 and Corr.1 applied.

400.description: un missing, no UN number read, more than 200 unique UN numbers (reason LIST_TOO_LONG), or an unknown parameter — refused by name.

reason.description: Set when the list has more unique UN numbers than one check takes.

401.description: An API key was sent and is not valid.

429.description: Rate limit reached (anonymous 25/day; the key's plan otherwise).

used.description: Floor positions the load needs (stacked pallets share a position). For a footprint other than Euro or UK, Euro-pallet equivalents.

available.description: Floor positions the vehicle offers for this pallet standard: the record's own count when its palletCapacityBasis is floor-positions, otherwise derived from its internal length x width (see floor_positions_basis). null for a custom vehicle.

floor_positions_basis.description: Where available came from: the record's floor count, the deck geometry, the loading-metre convention (no internal width on the record), or not available (custom vehicle).

floor_positions_note.description: One sentence on how available was arrived at.
floor_positions_note.example: 15 Euro (1200 x 800) floor positions from the 6.1 x 2.4 m deck (the better orientation, cross-checked against the loading-metre convention). The record's stored 8 is weight-limited, not a floor count.

record_count.description: The vehicle record's stored pallet count for this standard, as stored (it may be weight-limited or unverified rather than a floor count).

record_count_basis.description: The record's palletCapacityBasis: floor-positions, weight-limited or unverified.

length_mm.description: Pallet length in mm as interpreted.

width_mm.description: Pallet width in mm as interpreted.

total_weight_kg.description: Total weight of all pallets in kg, or null if weight not provided.

payload_checked.description: true when a weight was given and checked against the vehicle's max payload. false: fits reflects the floor and length only, and warnings[] carries an info note with the payload figure.

fits.description: true only when the load fits the vehicle's length, its floor positions (pallet_spaces.available) and, when a weight is given, its max payload. Each failed constraint is named in warnings[] with its numbers.

warnings.description: Warnings about the load and the request. Each is an object. A deprecated vehicle id yields warnings[0] with type=info and a message starting DEPRECATED: vehicle="<id>".

type.description: danger = the load does not fit or is overweight; warn = close to a limit; info = advisory, including vehicle deprecation.

total_cbm.description: Total cubic metres for all pieces.

total_volume_m3.description: Total volume in cubic metres (same as total_cbm).

chargeable_weight_kg.description: The chargeable weight (higher of actual vs volumetric).

basis.description: Whether the chargeable weight is based on 'actual' gross weight or 'volumetric' weight.

volumetric_weight_per_piece_kg.description: Volumetric weight per piece in kg.

boxes_per_layer.description: Number of boxes fitting in a single layer.

layers.description: Number of layers that fit within the height constraint.

total_boxes.description: Total number of boxes fitting on the pallet.

orientation.description: Whether boxes were rotated for best fit.

boxes_per_row.description: Number of boxes per row along the pallet length.

boxes_per_col.description: Number of boxes per column along the pallet width.

usable_height_cm.description: Usable stacking height after subtracting deck height.

total_box_volume_cbm.description: Total volume of all boxes in CBM.

weight_limited.description: Whether the result was limited by weight rather than space.

total_weight_kg.description: Total weight of all boxes, or null if box weight not provided.

remaining_weight_capacity_kg.description: Remaining weight capacity, or null if not applicable.

un_number.description: UN number identifying the dangerous goods.

proper_shipping_name.example: MOTOR SPIRIT or GASOLINE or PETROL

packing_group.description: Packing group (I, II, or III). Null when the entry has none — including Table A rows flagged not_subject_to_adr or carriage_prohibited.

not_subject_to_adr.description: Present and true when ADR 2025 Table A lists the entry as NOT SUBJECT TO ADR — the entry is outside ADR scope (road) and the 1.1.3.6 exemption calculation does not apply. See conditions_ref for carriage conditions that still apply.

carriage_prohibited.description: Present and true when ADR 2025 Table A lists the entry as CARRIAGE PROHIBITED — it may not be carried by road under ADR.

conditions_ref.description: ADR section whose carriage conditions still apply to a not-subject entry (e.g. 5.5.3 for UN 1845 dry ice: ventilation, warning mark, documentation). Null when no conditions attach.

table_a_remark.description: Verbatim ADR 2025 Table A column (4) remark for scope-flagged entries. Table A prints the same remark across columns (12)–(19); those 12 fields serve null on these rows.
table_a_remark.example: NOT SUBJECT TO ADR except for 5.5.3

decision_rationale.description: Data-integrity rationale recorded for this row, where present.

labels.description: Table A column (5), the hazard labels. The string "None" is the Table A value on UN 2211 and UN 3314 and means no label is required; null means the cell is empty.

special_provisions.description: Applicable special provisions (Table A column 6); null when the row lists none.

packing_instructions.description: Table A column (8), packing instructions (e.g. P001 IBC02 R001). Null when the column is empty.

special_packing_provisions.description: Table A column (9a), special packing provisions (e.g. PP1 BB2).

mixed_packing_provisions.description: Table A column (9b), mixed packing provisions (e.g. MP19).

portable_tank_instructions.description: Table A column (10), portable tank and bulk container instructions (e.g. T4).

portable_tank_special_provisions.description: Table A column (11), portable tank and bulk container special provisions (e.g. TP1 TP8).

tank_code.description: Table A column (12), ADR tank code (e.g. LGBF). Null on the 28 scope-flagged rows (not_subject_to_adr / carriage_prohibited), as are the other columns (8)–(14) and (16)–(19): Table A prints the row remark across those columns, and it is served in table_a_remark.

tank_special_provisions.description: Table A column (13), ADR tank special provisions (e.g. TU9).

vehicle_for_tank_carriage.description: Table A column (14), vehicle for tank carriage (e.g. FL, AT).

carriage_packages.description: Table A column (16), special provisions for carriage, packages (e.g. V12).

carriage_bulk.description: Table A column (17), special provisions for carriage, bulk (e.g. VC1 VC2 AP2).

carriage_loading_unloading_handling.description: Table A column (18), special provisions for carriage, loading, unloading and handling (e.g. CV13 CV28).

carriage_operation.description: Table A column (19), special provisions for carriage, operation (e.g. S2 S20).

variant_index.description: Index of this variant (0-based) when a UN number has multiple entries.

variant_count.description: Total number of variants for this UN number.

verified.description: Per-row verification state, ALWAYS present. true (or "partial") only when this row carries a row-level audit in the dataset; false otherwise. Silence is never verification.

verification.description: Why `verified` says what it says. status verified/partial = a row-level audit (basis row: audited_at + cited source count); status unverified = no row-level audit, the row is transcribed from the UNECE ADR 2025 Table A and held by the dataset-level checks only (basis dataset).

reason.example: No row-level audit. Transcribed from the UNECE ADR 2025 Table A and held by the dataset-level checks only (56 anchor rows carry a row-level audit).

audited_at.description: ISO date of the row-level audit. Present only with status verified/partial.

sources.description: Number of cited sources on the row-level audit. Present only with status verified/partial.

audited_at.description: ISO date of the row-level audit. Present only on audited rows.

sources.description: The row-level audit's cited sources. Present only on audited rows.

resolved_codes.description: Absent when include_codes=none: one entry per distinct code in the answer's rows, in order of first appearance.

items.description: Array of dangerous goods items to calculate.

un_number.description: UN number of the substance — or an ID-prefixed air-only number (e.g. ID8000), no Table A entry: counted out of 1.1.3.6 (AIR_ONLY_ID) only with icao_limited_quantity: true (ICAO TI limited quantities, 3.4.9/3.4.10); otherwise BLOCKED.

quantity.description: Quantity in kg or litres, a JSON number ≥ 0 and ≤ 1e9. 0 means not carried: the line is left out (EXCLUDED_NIL) and named in a warning; all zeros is a 400. Text ("300 kg"), null or a negative value is a 400 — never scored.

packing_group.description: Packing group — only needed for a UN number with more than one ADR Table A row (e.g. UN 1789); ignored for single-row UNs. Without it that line is withheld while its siblings are answered. Enough alone when the rows it leaves agree on the verdict fields (UN 1790 PG I).

variant_index.description: ADR Table A variant index (as returned by /api/adr) — pins one row when a UN number has several variants sharing a packing group (concentration bands). Ignored for single-row UN numbers. A JSON integer; anything else is a 400.

unit.description: OPTIONAL dimension of quantity, checked against the 1.1.3.6.3 basis for the row. Case-insensitive; any other value is a 400.

basis.description: OPTIONAL. A gross mass on an entry counted by mass is used only as an upper bound of the net mass, and the load is exempt on it only if it clears even so (figure_basis upper_bound_gross); otherwise, and for litres entries, no points. Any other value is a 400.

icao_limited_quantity.description: OPTIONAL, on an ID-prefixed line only (on a UN-numbered line it is a 400): true states that the packages are limited quantities conforming to the ICAO Technical Instructions (the 3.4.8 mark, or 3.4.10). Only then is the line counted out of 1.1.3.6 (1.1.3.4.2, 1.1.3.6.5).

edition.description: ADR edition "2025" or "2027"; wins over as_of. Omitted, as_of picks it: before 2027-01-01 ADR 2025; to 2027-06-30 ADR 2027 with an EDITION_TRANSITIONAL notice (ADR 2025 still allowed, 1.6.1.1); from 2027-07-01 ADR 2027 only (2025 refused, EDITION_UNSUPPORTED, 422). /api-docs#adr-editions

as_of.description: YYYY-MM-DD the answer is for (default today, UTC). Picks the ADR edition when edition is omitted; echoed in adr_edition, the 1.2 envelope and the check receipt.

AdrCalculatorRequest.description: items[] carries every line. Any single-substance field — un_number, quantity, packing_group, variant_index, unit, basis (or un / qty) — sent at the top level beside items[] is refused with HTTP 400 naming it: never dropped, never applied to a line by guess.

un_number.description: UN number of the substance — or, on an air-only line, the canonical ID number (e.g. ID8000).

state.description: The line's route: COUNTED (one Table A row), AIR_ONLY_ID (ID-prefixed, stated ICAO limited quantities, nothing counted), NOT_SUBJECT_TO_ADR, BLOCKED (no points from the line as sent; its flag says why) or EXCLUDED_NIL (quantity 0, not carried).

proper_shipping_name.description: Official ADR proper shipping name. Null on a withheld line (no row was pinned — never the first row's name).
proper_shipping_name.example: MOTOR SPIRIT or GASOLINE or PETROL

class.description: ADR hazard class. Null on a withheld line whose candidate rows differ in class.

transport_category.description: Transport category (0-4). Null on a withheld line.

packing_group.description: The resolved ADR Table A packing group for this row (echoed so a multi-variant resolution is traceable). On a withheld line: the packing group the caller supplied, or null.

variant_index.description: The resolved ADR Table A variant index for this row. Null on a withheld line.

multiplier.description: Points multiplier for this transport category. Null for out-of-scope rows (not_subject_to_adr / carriage_prohibited) and withheld lines — they never enter the points math.

points.description: Calculated points (quantity x multiplier). Null for out-of-scope rows, basis mismatches and withheld lines.

quantity_unit.description: Echo of the unit the caller declared (null when none was declared).

quantity_basis.description: Echo of the basis the caller declared (null when none was declared).

expected_unit.description: The dimension ADR 1.1.3.6.3 counts this row in — L for liquids and compressed gases, kg for solids, liquefied/refrigerated/dissolved gases and articles; null when the row does not pin one.

basis_mismatch.description: Present and true when the declared unit or basis cannot be a 1.1.3.6.3 quantity for this row. The line never enters the points math; total_points and exempt are null (unless the load is already settled by other lines).

category_unresolved.description: Present and true when the row carries no transport category in Table A column (15) — a dash (e.g. UN 3166) or 'See SP 671' (UN 3316 kits): no 1.1.3.6 multiplier, so points, total_points and exempt are null and a warning names the column value.

withheld.description: Present and true when this line's UN resolves to more than one ADR Table A row and nothing pinned one. Row fields are null; the candidate rows sit under the response's candidates[] tagged with this line's item_index. total_points and exempt are null while any line is withheld.

ambiguity_reason.description: Why the withheld line could not be pinned. Present only with withheld.

equivalent_variants.description: Present when the supplied packing_group left several Table A rows that agree on class, transport category, scope and the 1.1.3.6.3 counted dimension: the rows this verdict holds for. The row fields above are the first one's.

variant_note.description: Plain-language statement of the equivalence: which rows, which fields they share, whose fields are shown. Present only with equivalent_variants.

not_subject_to_adr.description: Present and true when this row is NOT SUBJECT TO ADR (Table A) — excluded from the 1.1.3.6 calculation.

carriage_prohibited.description: Present and true when this row is CARRIAGE PROHIBITED (Table A) — the load cannot be carried by road under ADR.

conditions_ref.description: ADR section whose carriage conditions still apply to a not-subject row (e.g. 5.5.3).

air_only_id.description: Present and true on an ID-prefixed air-only line: no ADR Table A entry, row fields null, never in the points — the ADR answer for limited-quantity packages to the ICAO TI (3.4.9, 3.4.10, 1.1.3.6.5), stated in the warning. Never not_subject_to_adr.

entry_required.description: Present (true) on an ID-prefixed line sent without icao_limited_quantity: no Table A entry and nothing establishes 3.4.9 / 3.4.10, so the line is BLOCKED.

icao_limited_quantity.description: Echo: the request stated icao_limited_quantity: true for this ID-prefixed line.

nil_quantity.description: Present (true) on a line sent with quantity 0: read as not carried and left out of every sum and test.

upper_bound_gross.description: Present (true) on a gross mass counted as an upper bound of the net mass, on a load that clears on it.

edition_basis.description: The edition whose Table A row the line was counted on, when it is not the edition asked for: 2025 on an ADR 2027 answer given on the 1.6.1.1 basis because the line's ADR 2027 entry is deleted (strict_adr_2027.entry_deleted).

blocking_errors.description: Present only on the all-ambiguous 200 (no verdict): [{ code: AMBIGUOUS_UN_VARIANT, message, recovery }], in the plain body too. recovery.params never pick a row (sent unchanged: asked again); pick from candidates[] by packing group, concentration or description; send packing_group or variant_index.

total_points.description: Sum of all item points. Null when no load verdict was reached — a line is withheld (items[].withheld), declared on a basis 1.1.3.6.3 does not count (items[].basis_mismatch), or carries no transport category in Table A column (15) (items[].category_unresolved).

exempt.description: Whether the shipment qualifies for 1.1.3.6 exemption. Null when no load verdict was reached, never false as a stand-in. false with total_points null = already NOT exempt on the resolved lines (carriage prohibited, category 0, a maximum exceeded, or a partial sum over 1,000) while a line is withheld.

has_category_zero.description: Whether any item is transport category 0 (never exempt).

has_quantity_exceedance.description: Whether any single item exceeds its maximum quantity per transport unit.

message.description: Human-readable verdict. For loads whose entries are outside ADR scope this is a dedicated scope verdict (e.g. 'Not subject to ADR (road). Section 5.5.3 applies: ...' or 'Carriage prohibited by ADR (road). ...'), never a 1.1.3.6 claim.

not_subject_to_adr.description: Present and true when EVERY item in the load is NOT SUBJECT TO ADR (Table A) — the 1.1.3.6 calculation was not applied.

conditions_ref.description: ADR section whose carriage conditions still apply to a not-subject load (e.g. 5.5.3 for dry ice).

conditions.description: Verbatim ADR 2025 carriage conditions for conditions_ref (e.g. section 5.5.3: ventilation, package marking, vehicle warning mark, documentation, unpackaged dry ice, training).

note.description: Verbatim accompanying note/example from ADR 2025, where one exists.

carriage_prohibited.description: Present and true when the load contains a CARRIAGE PROHIBITED Table A entry — exempt is false and the load may not be carried by road under ADR, whether or not another line is withheld.

human_review_required.description: Present and true when at least one line is withheld for an unpinned multi-variant UN. candidates[] then lists that line's rows.

candidates.description: The withheld lines' candidate Table A rows, each tagged with the item_index and un_number of the line it belongs to. Present only with human_review_required.

expected_unit.description: The 1.1.3.6.3 counted dimension of the candidate row — the only difference between two candidates when a packing group collides on state alone (UN 3375 PG II: liquid in L, solid in kg).

resolved_subtotal_points.description: Points of the lines that resolved (state COUNTED). Present on every verdict.

threshold_exceeded_by_resolved_items.description: The resolved lines alone exceed the 1,000-point threshold: unresolved lines can only add points, so the load is not exempt.

verdict_basis.description: all_items: every line resolved. resolved_items_alone: a verdict settled by the resolved lines while others are BLOCKED. none: no verdict (exempt null).

unresolved_item_indexes.description: Indexes of the BLOCKED lines (withheld, basis mismatch, category unresolved, invalid quantity).

basis.description: ADR 2027 answers: what the verdict rests on — adr_2027, or a transitional measure open on the stated as_of that clears a load ADR 2027 does not: 1.6.1.61 (note-a rule) before 1.6.1.1 (ADR 2025), with basis_until and strict_adr_2027 beside it. Deleted entries (UN 2941): 1.6.1.1 to 2027-06-30.

basis_until.description: The last day the transitional basis may be applied (with basis 1.6.1.61 or 1.6.1.1).

strict_adr_2027.description: Beside a verdict given on a transitional basis: the load on ADR 2027 itself (basis, total_points, exempt, has_category_zero, has_quantity_exceedance). An entry ADR 2027 deletes adds entry_deleted, deleted_un_numbers and message, with the four figures null.

transitional_1_6_1_61.description: ADR 2027 answers carrying one of the nine note-a UN numbers: the load on the 1.6.1.61 basis (points_on_this_basis, exempt_on_this_basis, until 2030-12-31, note).

transitional_1_6_1_1.description: ADR 2027 answers inside the 1.6.1.1 window (a stated as_of to 30 June 2027) where ADR 2027 itself is not exempt: the load on ADR 2025 (points_on_this_basis, exempt_on_this_basis, until 2027-06-30, note).

figure_basis.description: Present when the load clears on a gross mass counted as an upper bound of the net mass; its true points are lower.

has_cargo.description: Whether the airline operates cargo services.

status.description: Per-record verification status. active_verified: every served identifier confirmed against carrier-published pages (ICAO/callsign via FAA JO 7340.2), cited in field_provenance. historical: ceased operating, codes kept as fact. unverified: audited, not cleared. Absent = never audited.

status_checked_at.description: ISO date the verification status was last established. Absent when `status` is absent.

data_note.description: Plain-language caveat about this record's evidence, when one applies (e.g. why it is held at unverified).

field_provenance.description: Per-FIELD source citations: keys are field names (iata_code, icao_code, awb_prefix, callsign, operating_status, operational_status, restrictions, cargo_website, …), values the sources, with sha256 where recorded. grade second_class marks Wikidata (CC0). Aggregators never appear.

sources.description: Record-level union of the per-field citations.

verified.description: DEPRECATED — computed mirror of status==='active_verified', kept for one release. ABSENT (not false) on never-audited records, because false would assert a check that never happened. Read status instead.

prefix_shared.description: Every record with an AWB prefix: true when another record holds one of its prefixes — the prefix alone then does not name the issuing carrier. Computed from the data.

prefix_holders.description: Every record holding this record's prefix(es), as slugs, in the shared holder order (verified first, ceased last); this record included.

operational_status.description: Cargo records: whether the carrier operates (not the same as `status`, the identifiers' verification). active: the carrier's own page, or its ICAO designator in the current FAA JO 7340.2; ceased: its own page, or the designator withdrawn plus a dead domain; Wikidata alone: unknown.

operational_status_basis.description: What operational_status rests on; its sources are in field_provenance.operational_status. Absent when operational_status is unknown.

operational_status_since.description: Only when a source states the date.

restrictions.description: Cargo records named by a public air-safety list — a flag with its source, never a judgement: the EU Air Safety List (Annex A ban, Annex B restrictions; the Annex to the latest Commission Implementing Regulation amending Reg. (EC) 474/2006) or the UK Air Safety List.

since.description: First listed — null: neither list states it per carrier.

restricted.description: The restriction as the list states it, when it is partial.

cargo_website.description: Carrier-published cargo site (answered HTTP 200 at ingest). Absent when no carrier page qualifies.

tracking_url_template.description: Carrier-published AWB tracking URL with {prefix} / {serial} placeholders; stored only after its page answered HTTP 200 at ingest.

dg_acceptance_url.description: Carrier-published dangerous-goods acceptance page (HTTP 200 at ingest).

code_history.description: Dated designator changes, only where a source gives the date (Wikidata end-time qualifiers, second-class).

chargeable_weight_ref.description: Slug of this carrier's volumetric-divisor record on /chargeable-weight/{slug} — linked, not copied.

seller_responsibility.description: What the seller is responsible for.

buyer_responsibility.description: What the buyer is responsible for.

risk_transfer.description: Point at which risk transfers from seller to buyer.

cost_transfer.description: Point at which cost responsibility transfers.

best_for.description: Scenarios this term is best suited for.

watch_out.description: Common pitfalls or things to be aware of.

internal_height_cm.description: Internal height in cm. NULL on open decks (flat racks) — no roof, so no bounding height. Read height_basis to learn what a null means. Never 0: a zero here would make a length x width x height calculation return zero volume.

capacity_cbm.description: Internal volume in CBM. NULL on open decks (flat racks), which have no roof and no side walls and therefore no cubic capacity — read capacity_basis, and use deck_area_sqm instead. Never 0.

euro_pallets.description: DEPRECATED — use euro_pallets_min / euro_pallets_max. A string, and sometimes an EN-DASH range such as "23–24", so Number() returns NaN and parseInt() silently discards the upper bound. Kept unchanged for back-compat and now derived from the numeric pair. Will be removed in a future major version.

gma_pallets.description: DEPRECATED — use gma_pallets_min / gma_pallets_max. A numeric value stored as a string. Kept unchanged for back-compat and now derived from the numeric pair. Will be removed in a future major version.

euro_pallets_min.description: EUR pallets (1200x800mm) that fit — the conservative figure. Always numeric. Replaces euro_pallets.

euro_pallets_max.description: Upper bound when the achievable EUR-pallet count is genuinely a range (depends on overhang tolerance and whether the last row is turned). Null when the figure is exact.

gma_pallets_min.description: GMA pallets (48x40in) that fit — the conservative figure. Always numeric. Replaces gma_pallets.

gma_pallets_max.description: Upper bound when the GMA-pallet count is a range; null when exact.

deck_area_sqm.description: Deck area in m² — the meaningful capacity figure for an open deck (flat racks), where a cubic capacity does not exist. Null on enclosed containers.

pallet_capacity_basis.description: Which constraint the pallet counts express. Container counts are 'industry-convention' because published figures assume a pinwheel load and exceed an aligned-row tiling of the same floor.

height_basis.description: What internal_height_cm means, INCLUDING what a null means. 'unbounded-open-top' = no roof, so no height constraint exists (flat racks; height is null). 'constrained-removable-roof' = a real roof-fitted height on a unit whose roof comes off (open tops). Never infer this from open_top.

open_top.description: Affirmative physical fact: the unit has no fixed roof. NOT the discriminator for what a null height means — read height_basis for that.

capacity_basis.description: What capacity_cbm is. Carrier-published capacities do NOT equal length x width x height, so an agent computing volume from dimensions and an agent reading capacity_cbm will differ; this says which figure is held. 'not-applicable-open-deck' means capacity_cbm is null because the unit is unbounded.

max_gross_basis.description: Which authority max_gross_kg comes from. 'iso-668-series-1' is a regulatory ceiling and is frequently LOWER than what carriers actually operate — where it applies, max_payload_kg (derived as max gross minus tare) understates usable payload.

within_payload.description: Whether total weight is within payload limit.

description.example: Coffee, whether or not roasted or decaffeinated

parent.description: The parent heading or chapter code; null for a chapter (the nomenclature places a chapter in a Section, carried in section, and gives it no parent code).
The parent heading or chapter code; null for a chapter.

matched_via.description: Present only when the HS 2022 descriptions found nothing and HMRC's UK Trade Tariff search references named the code(s).

reference.description: HMRC's reference title, when the search returns one.

hscode.description: The code in this dataset the line falls under.

SourceEnvelope.description: Additive provenance citation for the dataset or method behind this response, from FreightUtils' single provenance source of truth. Shapes: reference, methodology (calculators), or reference with provenance_status:'pending-verification'. Fields appear only when a real value exists.

dataset_edition.description: Edition this response is served from (editioned reference datasets only), e.g. 'UN/LOCODE 2025-1'.

authority_current_edition.description: The authority's current in-force edition at the last check. Differs from dataset_edition only when the served data lags the authority.

checked_at.description: YYYY-MM-DD of the last served-vs-authority edition comparison (on-demand checker, staleness-guarded).

EmissionsResponse.description: Freight emissions result. available:true carries inputs/tonne_km/factor/emissions/_source; available:false carries message/available_for. methodology + disclaimer are always present.

summary.description: Primary human-readable one-line result — carries the empty-running + actual-gross-mass notes and, for sea/air, a high-variance warning.

mass_basis.description: Mass basis the factor expects: always "actual_gross_mass" — not chargeable/volumetric weight.

empty_running.description: "sector_average_included" (fleet-average empty running already in the factor — do not add your own empty-return leg) or "see_source".

representativeness.description: "low" for sea/air (high real-world variance by vessel/aircraft type, load, routing); "medium" for road/rail/inland.

_source.description: Citability envelope: ISO method + the exact open factor used.

last_verified.description: Date the factor was last verified against its cited source (YYYY-MM-DD).

ValidateResponse.description: Structural validation result. `found` lists every identifier detected (ordered by position); `note` is present when nothing was found.

raw.description: The candidate as found in the input

details.description: Type-specific: container → owner_prefix, equipment_category(_label), serial; awb → airline_prefix, serial, airline|null; shared prefix: airline_candidates[{name,iata,icao,status?}] + airline_note; airline_failure UNKNOWN_PREFIX / AMBIGUOUS; imo → number; malformed → error.

_source.description: Methodology citation for the identifier scheme.

failure.description: Present exactly when valid is false.

note.description: Present when no identifier was found

failure.description: On a 400 for a type the validator does not check: reason UNSUPPORTED_TYPE.

Ics2CheckResponse.description: ICS2 stop-words check result. The Commission's whitelist of accepted goods descriptions (ICS2 Common Repository, from 17 November 2026) is applied first: a whole description that is a whitelist entry is not flagged. A flagged term will likely cause an ENS rejection; a clean result is not acceptance.

note.description: Standalone (automatic ENS rejection) vs embedded (make the description more specific)

clean.description: True if no listed stop-word found, or if the whole description is a Commission whitelist entry (then whitelist_match is present) — NOT a guarantee of acceptance

whitelist_match.description: Present only when the whole description is an entry of the Commission's ICS2 goods-description whitelist that contains a stop word (case, punctuation and whitespace aside; singular and plural of the last word interchangeable). Those stop words are not flagged; a longer line is checked as before.

entry.description: The whitelist entry, as the Commission lists it

stop_words_contained.description: The listed stop words the entry contains, not flagged for this exact description

filename.description: The document's file name on EU CIRCABC

implementation_date.description: Common Repository implementation date of the entry (2026-11-17)

caveat.description: Non-exhaustive-list caveat: clean does not mean accepted

_source.description: Citability envelope: EU ICS2 list authority, legal basis, version + provenance.

icao_code.description: ICAO location indicator (OurAirports icao_code), or null.

scheduled_service.description: OurAirports scheduled_service: the airport has scheduled airline service.

iso_region.description: ISO 3166-2 region code (OurAirports iso_region), beside the readable region.

gps_code.description: OurAirports gps_code, only where it differs from the ICAO code; else null.

keywords.description: OurAirports keywords — former names and alternative spellings — or null.

distance_km.description: Great-circle distance from the query point, km

distance_basis.description: Distances are great-circle (haversine) from the given point to the airport reference point.

filter.description: scheduled_iata (default): airports with scheduled airline service and an IATA code, no heliports; all: include_all=true; type: the type parameter.

meta.description: Echo of the query (latitude, longitude, radius_km, max_results, type, include_all) + source.

ResolveCandidate.description: One resolution candidate. Ambiguity is the product: colliding grammars each contribute candidates, ranked deterministically with an inspectable rank_basis.

entity_type.description: What the candidate is: dangerous_good, airline, airport, location, hs_classification, incoterm, container_type, container_equipment, uld_type, tunnel_restriction, adr_code, air_waybill, vessel.

identifier_type.description: Which grammar matched: un_number, awb_prefix, airline_iata, airline_icao, airport_iata, airport_icao, unlocode, container_number, hs_code, incoterm, tunnel_code, uld_type, iso_container_type, adr_code, awb_number, imo_number; airport_ident or airline_slug for a record with no usable code.

summary.description: One-line human summary of the candidate.
summary.example: London Heathrow Airport — London, United Kingdom

record.description: Core fields from the matching dataset. Null for a pattern-only match (the value fits a grammar but is not in the served dataset).

verification_status.description: Normalized across datasets: active_verified, verified, computed, partial, pending_verification, unchecked, unverified, historical, pattern_only.

verification_basis.description: record = from this record's own provenance fields; dataset = the dataset-level claim (no record-level signal exists).

rank_basis.description: Why the candidate sits where it does: record hit > verification status > static dataset prior > stable tiebreak.

canonical_url.description: The record's page on freightutils.com, where one exists. Omitted otherwise.

api_url.description: The dataset's REST query for this record, where one exists.

citation.description: The matching dataset's own citation for this record (text + optional qualifier).

ResolveResponse.description: Envelope v1.1 (native); ?envelope=1.2 adds status, missing_inputs, edition and as_of (EnvelopeV12Fields). result holds the resolution; each candidate carries its own dataset citation. Zero candidates is ok:true with count 0 and a note, never an error.

normalized.description: After trim, uppercase, space/dash collapse and UN-prefix strip.

note.description: Present only when count is 0: 'no known freight identifier grammar matched'.

validation.description: When the query is an identifier with a check digit (AWB, container, IMO): the check, run as it resolved.

failure.description: NO_MATCH (no grammar matched) or AMBIGUOUS (several candidates; candidate_types names them).

confidence.description: high/deterministic when candidates exist; low/deterministic with a NO_MATCH warning when none do.

warnings.description: Advisory only. NO_MATCH is emitted on every count:0 response.

normalized_input.description: Present when normalization changed the query (lowercase, spacing, dashes, UN prefix): q_input + normalized.

blocking_errors.description: Present on the 400 branches only: MISSING_INPUT (no q) or INVALID_INPUT (over the 32-char single-token limit).

citation.description: Top-level one-line citation for the resolution itself; per-candidate dataset citations live on each candidate.

missing_inputs.description: Input names a partial answer needs; empty otherwise.

edition.description: Served edition; null for computed or live answers.

IdentifyMeta.description: Top-level `_meta` under `?envelope=1.2` only. `identify` (anonymous answers). `check_id` / `receipt_url`: the receipt of a check made with an API key (a free key is enough), kept 90 days. `receipt`: a check made without a key — nothing stored, the hash inline.

check_id.description: Check receipts: the id of this executed check (128 random bits), issued only for a call made with an API key (free or Pro). Also in the X-FreightUtils-Check-Id header on every form.

receipt_url.description: GET this URL for the receipt of the check. Also in the X-FreightUtils-Receipt header.

missing_inputs.description: Input names a partial answer needs; empty otherwise.

edition.description: Served edition; null for computed or live answers.

checked.description: YYYY-MM-DD of the last content audit, or "request-time".

ConsignmentObject.description: The consignment object (consignment-object.v1): lines[] (required), journey, vehicle, options. The consignment argument of consignment_calculator, shipment_summary and adr_exemption_calculator; the body of POST /api/adr/consignment-check; validated by POST /api/validate. No parties.

description.description: What the line is, at most 200 characters.

un_number.description: UN number of a dangerous-goods line, or an ID-prefixed air-only number ("ID 8000").

packing_group.description: Packing group, to pin one ADR Table A row of a multi-row UN.

variant_index.description: ADR Table A variant index (as adr_lookup returns it), to pin one row.

quantity.description: The dangerous-goods quantity (ADR 1.1.3.6.3), separate from the gross mass of the packages.

value.description: The dangerous-goods quantity for the whole line, all packages together. 0 = the goods are not carried (the line is left out of the 1.1.3.6 count and named in a warning).

unit.description: "L" or "kg" — checked against the dimension ADR 1.1.3.6.3 counts for the row.

basis.description: "net" (the goods) or "gross" (with packaging). 1.1.3.6.3 counts net; a gross figure scores no points.

packages.description: The pieces: how many, of what type, and their total gross mass.

count.description: Number of identical packages (pieces) on the line.

gross_kg.description: Gross mass of ALL the line's packages together, in kg.

un_mark.description: UN packaging mark as printed (ADR 6.1.3.1), e.g. "UN 4G/Y145/S/02/NL/VL823": (a) the symbol, (b) the 6.1.2.7 code, (c) the packing-group letter X / Y / Z and density or mass, (d) S or test pressure, (e) the year, (f) the State, (g) the maker; the letter is held against the line's packing group.

value.description: Customs value of the whole line (all packages together).

dims.description: Dimensions of ONE package: { l, w, h, unit: mm | cm | m | in }.

stackable.description: Whether the packages may be stacked.

icao_limited_quantity.description: On an ID-prefixed line only: the packages are limited quantities to the ICAO Technical Instructions (3.4.8 mark / 3.4.10). Without it such a line has no 1.1.3.6 verdict.

inner_packaging.description: The inner packaging of a line, for the limited / excepted quantity check (Table A columns (7a) / (7b)).

quantity.description: The quantity in ONE inner packaging.

per_outer.description: Inner packagings in one outer packaging (default 1) — the excepted-quantity outer limit.

regime.description: The exemption the line is meant to use: limited (lq) or excepted (eq) quantity. A stated regime that is missed fails. Omitted: both are checked, and a line that fits neither is not_applicable (the full requirements apply).

lines.description: The lines of the load. Required.

origin.description: UN/LOCODE or ISO country code of the origin.

destination.description: UN/LOCODE or ISO country code of the destination.

tunnels_on_route.description: ADR tunnel categories on the route (A–E).

max_mass_t.description: Maximum permissible mass, tonnes — read by adr_consignment_check as the transport unit's maximum permissible mass (ADR 8.1.4.1 column (1): the extinguisher band; 3.4.13: the limited-quantity mark on units over 12 t).

foodstuffs_carried.description: Whether packages known to contain foodstuffs, other articles of consumption or animal feeds are carried in the same vehicle or container as the lines (ADR 7.5.4, read by adr_consignment_check for goods with CV28). Omitted: the foodstuffs precaution is answered as a condition.

fire_extinguishers_kg.description: The capacity in kg (dry powder, or the equivalent for another agent) of each portable fire extinguisher on board (ADR 8.1.4.1: number, total and largest by the transport unit's maximum permissible mass; 8.1.4.2: one of 2 kg under 1.1.3.6).

orange_plates_displayed.description: Whether the transport unit displays the two rectangular orange-coloured plates, one at the front and one at the rear (ADR 5.3.2.1.1).

placards_displayed.description: Whether the vehicle displays the placards ADR 5.3.1.5 requires of a vehicle carrying packages (Class 1 other than 1.4S; Class 7 other than excepted packages), on both sides and at the rear.

equipment_8_1_5.description: The ADR 8.1.5.2 / 8.1.5.3 items on board, by name (vest, lighting, gloves, eye protection and escape mask for each crew member; escape mask for labels 2.3 / 6.1; shovel, drain seal, collecting container for labels 3, 4.1, 4.3, 8, 9). An item not listed is read as not on board.

instructions_in_writing.description: Whether the instructions in writing of ADR 5.4.3 are carried in the driver's cab (8.1.2.1 (b)).

crew.description: The vehicle crew, for adr_consignment_check's driver-training and document checks (ADR 8.2, 8.1.2). Facts only — no name.

adr_training_certificate.description: Whether the driver holds the ADR driver training certificate (8.2.1.1, the model of 8.2.2.8), valid on the date of carriage.

specialisations.description: The specialisations the driver's certificate carries (8.2.1.3 tanks; 8.2.1.4 Class 1, Class 7).

photo_identification.description: Whether each member of the vehicle crew carries a means of identification which includes a photograph (8.1.2.1 (d), 1.10.1.4).

awareness_training_1_3.description: Whether the driver has received training according to ADR Chapter 1.3 (8.2.3) — what a load carried under 1.1.3.6 keeps for a driver without the 8.2.1 certificate.

container_number.description: ISO 6346 container number (check digit validated, advisory).

awb_number.description: IATA air waybill number (check digit validated, advisory).

freight_cost.description: Freight cost for the customs value.

insurance_cost.description: Insurance cost for the customs value.

A needed field it lacks is a 400 MISSING_INPUT naming the path in missing_inputs ("lines[0].dims"); unread fields are listed in normalized_input.consignment.not_read.

ReceiptVerification.description: GET /api/receipts/{check_id}/verify: that a receipt exists and its hash, for anyone holding the id. Exactly these six fields; never the inputs, the result, the key or the account.

Receipt.description: The record of one executed check: redacted inputs, the edition it rested on and as_of (edition_basis when none), data hashes, engine SHA, rules, citations, result, not_proven. receipt.v2 hashes as_of and edition_basis too; a receipt.v1 is served as stored (X-FreightUtils-Receipt-Schema).

UnstoredReceipt.description: A check answered without a stored receipt: no API key (key_required), or a free key past its 25 stored receipts today (quota). receipt_hash.description: sha256 over the canonical JSON (keys sorted at every level) of created_at, tool, inputs, dataset_version, engine_version, result (from here) with edition, as_of and _meta.edition_basis (when present) from the envelope.

required.description: true (the load requires it), false (it does not), "under_relief_only" (only if the load is carried under 1.1.3.6), "conditional" (it turns on a fact the object does not carry — stated in conditions).

applies.description: true (the load requires it), false (it does not), "under_relief_only" (only if the load is carried under 1.1.3.6), "conditional" (it turns on a fact the object does not carry — stated in conditions).

outcome.description: The requirement against its input: pass / fail (the rule quoted in basis), conditional (an LQ / EQ relief or an unsettled 1.1.3.6 verdict could lift a shortfall), unanswered (the input was not sent: listed as optional in missing_inputs), not_required.

The requirement against its input: pass / fail (the rule quoted in basis), conditional (an LQ / EQ relief or an unsettled 1.1.3.6 verdict could lift a shortfall), unanswered (the input was not sent: listed as optional in missing_inputs), not_required.

The requirement against its input: pass / fail (the rule quoted in basis), conditional (an LQ / EQ relief or an unsettled 1.1.3.6 verdict could lift a shortfall), unanswered (the input was not sent: listed as optional in missing_inputs), not_required.

packaging_code_validity.description: ADR 6.1.3.1 (build 2d): each line's packages.un_mark read field by field and its packing-group letter held against the line's packing group. No mark: conditional. The packaging kind against the packing instruction is not checked.

field.description: On fail: the 6.1.3.1 sub-paragraph the mark breaks (c also when the letter does not cover the packing group).

parsed.description: The mark field by field: symbol, code, code_suffix, letter, covers, relative_density, max_gross_mass_kg, solids_or_inner, test_pressure_kpa, year, state, manufacturer.

reason.description: Why, with the rule quoted (section, volume, PDF page).

FuId.description: Stable, edition-free identifier of this record: fu:<namespace>:<segment>[:<segment>…]. A join key, the same in every edition, kept in an append-only ledger. Not a regulatory reference, a citation or a promise the content never changes. GET /api/resolve?q=<fu_id> returns it.

FuVersionId.description: The identifier of this edition's record: <fu_id>@<edition token>. Present only where the dataset has editions (ADR, HS, UN/LOCODE, airports, Incoterms, ADR codes, ICS2, emission factors); airlines, ULDs, containers, vehicles and pallets have none.

IdsMeta.description: On a v1.2 envelope whose records carry fu_id: the identifier scheme.

UpstreamMeta.description: The upstream state of the datasets this answer was drawn from (_meta.upstream on a v1.2 envelope; the X-FreightUtils-Upstream header on REST). stale is true only for window_missed; unknown = could not be read. It says the upstream was checked in its window, not that the answer is right.

state.description: The worst state of the datasets below.

stale.description: True only when a dataset below is window_missed.

state_read_at.description: When the site's upstream check recorded the state (ISO 8601); null when it could not be read.

datasets.description: One entry per dataset id the answer was drawn from (an ADR row and the ADR code meanings it refers to are two).

kind.description: watched: the upstream is fetched daily; checksum-only: no upstream of its own — the file's checksum and a review or edition-check cadence.

last_success.description: The last day (YYYY-MM-DD) every upstream the check reads answered and held its shape; null when none is recorded.

window_days.description: The declared window; null for a cadence-checked set.

reason.description: Present when state is unknown: why it could not be read.

StaleUpstreamProblem.description: HTTP 424 problem details, only for a caller who sent ?if_stale=refuse while a dataset of the answer missed its upstream window. Not retryable in seconds. Without the parameter the same request is answered, marked stale.

ClientLabel.name: client
ClientLabel.description: Optional caller label (up to 40 characters of A-Za-z0-9._-) so your calls are recognisable in our usage figures. Changes no answer. The X-FreightUtils-Client header does the same.

Envelope.name: envelope
Envelope.description: Response envelope: 1 (byte-stable), 1.1, or 1.2 (adds status, missing_inputs, edition, as_of). Omit for the plain body.

AdrEdition.name: edition
AdrEdition.description: ADR edition "2025" or "2027"; wins over as_of. Omitted, as_of picks it: before 2027-01-01 ADR 2025; to 2027-06-30 ADR 2027 with an EDITION_TRANSITIONAL notice (ADR 2025 still allowed, 1.6.1.1); from 2027-07-01 ADR 2027 only (2025 refused, EDITION_UNSUPPORTED, 422). /api-docs#adr-editions

AdrAsOf.name: as_of
AdrAsOf.description: YYYY-MM-DD the answer is for (default today, UTC). Picks the ADR edition when edition is omitted; echoed in adr_edition, the 1.2 envelope and the check receipt.

IfStale.name: if_stale
IfStale.description: refuse: answer HTTP 424 (stale_upstream) instead of serving stale while a dataset of this answer missed its upstream check window. Omit it (the default) to be served from the last verified edition with stale: true.

ApiKeyHeader.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyHeader.description: Free or Pro API key (fu_…). Optional: without one a call is anonymous (25/day per address).

BearerAuth.description: The same key as Authorization: Bearer fu_…

RateLimited.description: Rate limited: the daily (or monthly) allowance or a burst window is spent. Retry after Retry-After seconds, or send a key.

X-FreightUtils-Upstream.description: The upstream state of the datasets this answer was drawn from: the UpstreamMeta object as compact JSON, on every REST answer of a record lookup and of a calculator that read a served dataset (absent when it read none, e.g. a container check digit).
